candidates.comment: Thanks for the request. This is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/148069, including status-bar access and a Command Palette action. Your preference for an easily accessible action without the terminal or experimental repository explorer belongs in that discussion.

Thanks for the report. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/318088 already tracks WSL becoming unusable when the replacement server download fails after removal of the existing installation. This thread adds the Windows per-commit cache workaround: manually downloading the matching server archive before reopening VS Code restores installation. The desktop and server versions must still match, so retaining an older server alone is not sufficient recovery.

Thanks for the detailed reproduction. This is the stale chat snapshot overwrite tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/313703. Your nested-workspace steps and video with autosave enabled provide another concrete reproduction: reopening the pending conversation restores older contents over edits saved through the nested workspace. Those details should remain part of the fix's acceptance checks.

Thanks for the report. This is the same extension-provided server visibility gap tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/265912. This report adds the GitHub example: enabling github.copilot.chat.githubMcpServer.enabled makes GitHub appear in Configure Tools, but not in MCP Servers - Installed.

Thanks for the context. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/139726 already tracks an option to suppress this recurring banner while retaining Unicode highlighting, alongside configuring the highlighting limit. Your Japanese-file example and the banner returning after switching tabs are useful details to retain in that discussion.
